articleTitle: Synthesis of Waveguide Diaphragm Polarizers Using Wave Matrix Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Waveguide polarization converters perform the transformation of circularly polarized signals to linearly polarized signals in receiving antennas. In transmitting antennas they perform the inverse conversion of linearly polarized signals to circularly polarized signals. This paper presents a new synthesis method and its application for the development of optimal waveguide polarization converters with diaphragms. The chosen diaphragms-based design allows to improve the performance compared to designs with other types of discontinuities. The results of the performed synthesis method were presented for the polarizer operating in the satellite frequency range 10.7-12.8 GHz. The synthesized waveguide diaphragm polarization converter provides an output phase difference of 90° ± 2.8° in the whole operating satellite frequency range of 10.7-12.8 GHz. Its peak value of the standing wave factor by voltage is 1.67 for both linear polarizations. In addition, the minimum level of discrimination of the linear polarizations is 31 dB. The maximum level of calculated ellipticity parameter equals to 0.47 dB.

articleTitle: Compact Posts-Based Waveguide Polarizer for Satellite Communications and Radar Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this study we have developed and optimized a new compact guide polarizer with metal posts for satellite communications and radar systems. Its novelty consists in the possibility of fine tuning of the characteristics. Suggested polarizer design consists of a guide with a square cross section and two metal posts, which are located in the center. The posts were simulated as cylindrical conductors. The main electrical parameters of the developed waveguide polarizer with posts were calculated using the equivalent circuit technique, the theory of scattering and transmission wave matrices and the finite difference time domain method. The plots of magnitudes and phases of all scattering parameters of the developed device were obtained and optimized in the operating satellite frequency range of 14-14.5 GHz. The proposed polarization converter allows to obtain output phase difference 90°±1.6° in the entire operating frequency range. Simultaneously, the peak value of a standing wave factor by voltage is less than 1.34 for both orthogonal linear polarizations. Computed peak value of the elipticity parameter is 0.26 dB. The values of the obtained discrimination of linear polarization are better than −37 dB. Consequently, the results of performed study can be widely applied for the engineering of modern microwave polarization conversion devices for satellite and terrestrial systems.

articleTitle: Waveguide Polarizer for Radar Systems of 2 cm Wavelength Range
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper we carried out development and optimization of an effective waveguide polarization converter with five diaphragms for radar systems. Modern radio engineering systems operate in conditions of significant levels of interferences of various kinds. The presence of such interferences has a significant impact on the accuracy of the estimation of information parameters that are processed by radar systems. This significantly affects the analysis of information received by the system. To overcome this problem, modern radar systems use rather effective adaptive algorithms for processing of radio signals. Among them an essential place is occupied by the techniques of polarization signal processing and adaptation. It allows to improve the detection of observed by the radars objects and to increase the information capacity of information transmission channels. Such radar systems use adaptive antenna systems. The key element of such systems is a polarization converting device. It receives signals with linear polarization and generates circular polarization or vice versa. Such device is usually developed on the basis of circular or square waveguides. The phase difference at the output of a converter should be 90°. This is provided by reactive elements that are placed inside a waveguide. Developed in the research polarizer provides output phase difference 90°±1.5°. The maximum level of standing wave factor by voltage is 1.12. Therefore, designed waveguide polarizer ensures efficient polarization and matching performances. It can be applied in horn antennas for modern radars and information systems with dual-polarization operation.

articleTitle: Accounting For The Effect Of PV Panel Dustiness On System Performance With Correction For Panel Cleaning For Matlab Simulink
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The model of maneuvering unit based on generating and accumulating capacities, which are elements of an autonomous mobile settlement, is proposed. The generating, accumulating and maneuvering capacities are analyzed. Two types of neural networks for an integrated power system forecasting and analysis system are analyzed. The best option is selected. The variants of accumulator units placement according to the theory of reliability of electric power systems are analyzed. The role of this agile unit, its fate and functions in the power system are established.

articleTitle: Adjustable Iris-Post Waveguide Polarizer for Ku-band Satellite Uplink Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper presents the results of numerical optimization of main operating parameters of an adjustable waveguide polarizer for satellite uplink systems. The developed polarization conversion device has a waveguide structure, inside which two metal pins are located in the center of a broad wall. Besides, two thin metal diaphragms are symmetrically located on both sides of the pins. Mechanical adjustment of the heights of pins provides the ability of fine tuning of operating electromagnetic parameters. This is necessary and important feature for a polarizer, since it allows to reduce the influence of inaccuracies of the manufactured device's structure. Developed polarization converter introduces additional phase difference close to 90 degrees for the input linearly polarized fundamental waves at the output and maintains good matching for both modes. The combination of these properties results into an efficient transformation of circularly polarized electromagnetic waves into linearly polarized waves. The operating electromagnetic parameters of the considered waveguide device are expressed through the elements of its scattering wave matrix. Numerical simulations in the frequency range 14.0-14.5 GHz were carried out using the finite elements method in the frequency domain. Main performance characteristics were optimized, including output differential phase difference, standing wave factor, reflection and transmission coefficients, ellipticity parameter, discrimination of the linear polarization. The designed guide polarization converter with two pins and diaphragms provides an output phase difference of 90° ± 3.25° in the operating frequency range of 14.0-14.5 GHz. Its peak value of the standing wave factor by voltage is 1.15 for both linear polarizations. In addition, the maximum level of discrimination of the linear polarizations is −31 dB. The maximum level of ellipticity parameter equals to 0.48 dB. Obtained numerical results can be used to develop and estimate the characteristics of new adjustable waveguide polarizers with diaphragms and pins.

articleTitle: Optimal Measurement of Signal Data Parameters of Requesting Radar Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The presented work analyzes the effect of random loss of received signals due to the finite availability factor of aircraft responders of requesting radar surveillance systems on the optimal algorithm for processing response signals. It is shown that the optimal detection algorithm when the detector and the device for estimating the parameters of the received signal data work together is reduced to comparing the likelihood ratio averaged over the measured parameter with the threshold level. Its value is determined not only by the costs of errors of the first and second kind, but also by a priori data on the measured parameter, as well as by the results of processing the adopted implementation in the meter.

articleTitle: Optimization of Data Processing Structure for Multi-Position Radar Surveillance Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The optimal structure for processing signal data and primary processing data of a multi-position radar system is synthesized in this paper. In this work, due to the creation of an information base for storing signal data on the required number of scans of a multi-position radar system, it is possible to merge data both at the level of signal data and at the level of primary data processing. Each element of the last stores both signal data and indicators of the quality of their receipt. This made it possible to carry out inter-stage optimization of signal data processing and primary data processing.

articleTitle: Substantiation of Probability Characteristics for Efficiency Analysis in the Process of Radio Equipment Diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper discusses the problem of statistical characteristics substantiation during radio equipment diagnostics. To provide serviceability and maintainability of radio equipment is one of the tasks of operation system. The operation system contains the processes of intended use of equipment, maintenance, running repair, continuation of life service and others. During running repair, the procedures of diagnostics, operability recovery and parameters monitoring are performed. The diagnostics process regulates the sequence of searching the failed element in the radio equipment scheme. The decision-making during diagnostics is associated with the errors of the first and second kind. So for efficiency analysis, the probability of correct diagnostics can be used. Such efficiency measure has random nature, but in the literature, only expected value is used to describe it. This paper concentrates on the approach to calculation of the probability density function for efficiency measure with purpose of obtaining the complete information about random value.

articleTitle: Comparison of CNNs for Lung Biopsy Images Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Deep learning approaches are widely used in the processing of medical images, including histopathological images for cancer diagnosis. Therefore, the scientific and practical problem of automation of biopsy image analysis using convolutional neural networks is considered in the paper. The LC25000 dataset was used to compare the classification accuracy of different CNN architectures. To analyze the impact of image size, two more datasets were created from the initial dataset by slicing of the images. The correlation between the complexity of CNN structure, size of the images, and the resulted accuracy on test data was obtained. Results were compared with related researches on the LC25000 dataset. The theory of deep learning neural networks and mathematical statistics methods are used.

articleTitle: Algorithm Of Two-Stage Channel Frequency Response Estimation In OFDM Systems Based On Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: this paper describes and analyzes two-stage channel frequency response estimation method for OFDM systems. In this method pilots from current OFDM symbol are used and estimations based on pilots from previous OFDM symbols taken into account. In the first stage filtration of channel frequency response on pilots positions and it extrapolation on data positions in OFDM symbol is performed in time and frequency directions. In the second stage optimal combining of the results of first stage is performed. The statistical properties of the channel are assumed to be known.

articleTitle: Radio Wave Characteristics Distorted During Geospace Storm: Results of Multi-Frequency Multiple Path Oblique Sounding of Ionosphere
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We have made measurements of HF radio waves at the Harbin Engineering University, the People's Republic of China, during the geospace storm of August 30-September 2, 2019. Further, we have performed a general analysis of space weather, and afterwards the data and disturbances in the ionosphere have been analysed in order to determine the effect that the ionospheric storm had on the parameters of radio waves. The main results of this analysis could be summarised as follows. The magnetic storm power and energy have been calculated to be 9 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup>W and 1.5 ×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup>J, i.e., the storm was moderate. The geospace storm included a strong to moderate negative ionospheric storm. During August 31, 2019 and September 1, 2019, the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$F$</tex> region of the ionosphere showed a reduction in the electron density by a factor of 1.4 to 2.4 in comparison with the electron densities observed on the reference day. The geospace storm also caused notable disturbances in the midlatitude <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$E$</tex> region of the ionosphere, and in the sporadic E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</inf> layer. During the ionospheric storm, the heights of reflection could undergo a drastic rise from ~150 km to ~300-310 km. The geospace storm launched atmospheric gravity waves that modulated the electron density in the ionosphere.

articleTitle: Synthesis of a Regulator Recuperation Mode a DC Electric Drive by Creating a Process of Finite Duration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Analytical dependences describing the conditions for the implementation of finite duration processes in the regulation of armature and excitation windings of the DC motor in the modes of traction and regenerative braking are established. The synthesis of regulators of the two-circuit automatic control system which allows to realize the maximum speed is executed. Analytical expressions describing the dependences of the value of the pulsation factors of the step-down pulse converter depending on the value of the transfer functions of the regulators of the double-circuit automatic control system and the value of the duty cycle of the pulse-width modulation are established. An automatic control system has been developed that can be used in the practical design of dynamic braking systems by DC motors. The presented technique in Matlab simulation allows to determine power losses and temperature of power transistors of any types as a part of any semiconductor converter

articleTitle: Subsurface Object Detection in Randomly Inhomogeneous Medium Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The problem of hidden underground object detection in random inhomogeneous medium with the help of ground penetrating radar and artificial neural network is solving in the work. The irradiator generates a short Gaussian impulse electromagnetic wave which penetrates into the ground surface and propagates through the random inhomogeneous ground modelled by homogeneous medium with random inclusions with random distribution of placement, size and permittivity. The field reflected from buried object, model of antipersonnel mine, is detected by the system of four receiving antennas. The electromagnetic problem is numerically solved by FDTD method. Four-element antenna system is utilized to compensate the reflections from receiving antennas and the ground surface. Discretized result signal is used as input signal for artificial neural network. The artificial neural network is learnt to recognize hidden objects in homogeneous medium. The network is applied for classification of an object in heterogeneous medium and its coordinates in presence of Gaussian noise in received signals.

articleTitle: Simulation of Four- Directional Spoofing Suppression with Five-Elements Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper, a method and algorithm to solve the task of GNSS spoofing suppression with a five-element antenna array from four directions are presented. Initial data is experimental observations of 33 satellites (GPS, GLONASS, GALILEO, BEIDOU, QZSS). It is shown that with the simultaneous suppression of interference from four sources, 11 to 20 satellites out of 33 remain available to solve the navigation problem. Interference suppression is provided within the limits −65-78 dB and low position dilution of precision (PDOP). The results of the research are illustrated with satellite distribution (visibility) diagrams. The diagrams show the satellites that remain after the spoofing suppression procedure. The projections of the antenna array pattern on the plane of the aperture are given with an indication of interference sources positions.

articleTitle: Software Implemented Enhanced Efficiency BPSK Demodulator Based on Perceptron Model with Randomization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper presents a new method for noise-immune demodulation of BPSK signals. It is based on the use of an artificial neural network and signal randomization. Signal randomization increases self-synchronization properties and simplifies timing techniques. The demodulator model was designed and implemented in software. The demodulation bit error rate and standard deviation of normalized timing error were studied as a function of the signal-to-noise ratio. It was found out that the use of randomization reduces the normalized timing error by 7.5% at the normalized signal-to-noise ratio value of −15 dB. The method can be used to digital exchange data under strong interference conditions, in particular, in computer telecommunication systems, medical equipment, industrial networks, smart sensor networks and satellite communications.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Eigenvalue Problem for Twin Dielectric Rods Covered with Graphene: Symmetry Classes of the H-Polarized Supermodes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The electromagnetic eigenvalue problem for two identical circular dielectric nanowires with graphene covers is investigated. In particular, we consider the splitting of the optically coupled nanowire modes to independent symmetry classes. In our analysis, we use the Kubo formalism for the graphene conductivity, the resistive boundary conditions, the separation of variables in the local coordinates, and the addition theorems for the cylindrical functions. As a result, we derive eigenvalue equations for four different classes of symmetry for the natural modes of twin dielectric nanowires covered with graphene. Our analysis can be used in the modelling of the laser modes of such structures, since graphene is known as a possible material for plasmonic resonance elements of nanolasers.

articleTitle: Research of Transition Processes of Single-Phase Collector Motor With AC Voltage Controller Model Created on Project Design Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A model of an single-phase collector motor with alternating current supply and voltage regulation using one thyristor (half wave phase control) or two thyristors (full wave phase control) in MATLAB Simulink has been developed and further investigated on the basis of results of project design calculation, while all necessary motor parameters for mathematical models have been obtained. This model is based on existing models of universal motor and thyristor in the MATLAB Simscape library using real data. The obtained model has enabled to investigate the mechanical characteristics of the motor with alternating current supply and voltage regulation using one or two thyristors for different thyristor firing angles. The influence of the armature circuit inductance on the shape of the regulated supply voltage in the motor start and operation mode using the AC voltage controller is investigated. The importance of controlling the armature circuit inductance in the process of design calculation and the ways of reducing inductance are proved. It is shown that complex design reduction of the armature inductance and the use of RC-snubber allows to provide the lowest ripple of the motor supply voltage.

articleTitle: Research of Improved Traffic Engineering Fault-Tolerant Routing Mechanism in SD-WAN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A research of an improved Traffic Engineering fault-tolerant routing mechanism in Software-Defined Wide Area Networks (SD-WAN) is presented. The mathematical model allows formalizing the case of SD-WAN data plane construction, when each access network to increase fault-tolerance is switched simultaneously not to one but several border routers. The advantage of the solution is improving the level of fault-tolerance with load balancing in the data plane according to the criterion of Traffic Engineering by ensuring the distribution of packet flows using primary or backup routes at the access level between several gateways that create one virtual default gateway. The results of the numerical study of Traffic Engineering fault-tolerant routing processes confirmed the proposed model's effectiveness in implementing the default gateway protection scheme and load balancing in the network.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Bandwidth of the Communication Channel of 5G Networks Based on Small Cells
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of using 5G millimeter waves band (MM WB) in wireless communication systems of the next generation. The aim of the work is to clarify the calculation methods and estimate the availability parameters and performance of communication channels in the millimeter wavelength band when deploying 5G communication network segments in various climatic zones of Ukraine.

articleTitle: Far-Field Characteristics of Discrete Parabolic Reflector Made of Circular PEC Wires, Symmetrically Illuminated by Plane Waves
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We consider the two-dimensional scattering of the TE- and TM-polarized plane electromagnetic waves from a discrete parabolic reflector consisting of parallel circular perfectly electrically conducting wires. Our analysis is performed in the exact formulation, fully taking into account the wave interactions between the wires. We use the method of separation of variables in the local cylindrical coordinate systems in combination with Graf's addition formulas for cylindrical functions. The scattered field patterns and total scattering cross-sections are calculated and discussed.

articleTitle: Study of the Convergence of Muller's Sequence Computer Calculations
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The authors consider two known cases of incorrect computer calculations (the example of S. Rump and the example of J.-M. Muller). The work analytically investigates the case of violation of numerical stability for a nonlinear recurrent sequence of the second order. The authors built a closed-form solution that allows you to control the convergence of computer calculations.

articleTitle: Optimization of LED Drivers Depending on the Temperature of Their Operation in Lighting Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In the article, the influence of ambient temperature on such parameters of LEDs as forward and reverse current, forward voltage, luminous flux, service life was analyzed.-The model of the change in the parameters of LEDs from the ambient temperature has been builded. Recommendations on the choice of the LED operating mode depending on the temperature have been submitted.

articleTitle: Software Implementation of Data Hiding in Vector Images
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The work conducted a study of methods of concealing data into vector images, the features of their mathematical models, which make it possible to perform steganographic transformations for concealing and extracting information sequences. The purpose of the work was to analyze existing methods of concealing data into geometric elements of vector graphics, in particular the Bezier curves of the third order, the own programming implementation in the programming language JavaScript. Developed software implementation allows performing the operations of hiding and extracting messages in SVG files.

articleTitle: Lasing Eigenvalue Problem for a Circular Quantum Wire Partially Covered with Graphene
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We consider the Lasing Eigenvalue Problem (LEP) for a circular quantum wire, made of a gain material, with a partial cover, made of a graphene strip. This boundary value problem is reduced to a dual series equation for the Fourier series coefficients of the magnetic field function. Using the Riemann-Hilbert Problem solution, we transform this equation to a Fredholm second-kind set of linear algebraic equations. To find the LEP eigenvalues, we apply the method of the residual inverse iteration. Some preliminary results of the lasing mode frequencies, threshold gains and field patterns are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Technological Production Defects Influence on Response Function of Shaft Run-Out Sensor for Generator Fault Diagnosis System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper a present results of the model study of the technological production defects influence on response function of shaft run-out sensor for generator fault diagnosis system. The sensor is design for use for measurement control parameters of shaft run-out of powerful generators. One of the most important stages in the design of sensors before their implementation is to take into account the factors that can lead to the appearance of errors in the measurement of control parameters. These factors are technological production defects. To take into account technological production defects, models were implemented that made it possible to assess the character of the effect of defects on the sensor response function. The resulting family of response functions of the shaft run-out sensor made it possible to evaluate the influence of factors such as changes in the inter-electrode gap, electrode thickness, and dielectric substrate thickness. Studies on computer models in the future allows taking into account and making more accurate sensors, implementing the optimal design and choosing the optimal manufacturing technology for the sensor and the permissible error in determining the value of the shaft run-out parameters.

articleTitle: Assessing SSR Relative Data Capacity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Secondary Surveillance Radars are widely used in many aspects of users' information support, such as air object recognition and radio beacon tracking. The study considers a two-channel data transmission system as an SSR model and assesses its relative data capacity subject to intentional (correlated and uncorrelated) and intra-system interference as well as fluctuation (masking effect) noise in the request and response channels. It is shown that the aircraft transponder design built on the principles of a single-channel queuing system with denial of service has a significant impact on Secondary Surveillance Radar relative data capacity and the information security of both the aircraft transponder and the entire Secondary Surveillance Radar.

articleTitle: Computer Processing of Signals of Noncontact Ultrasonic System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The system of contactless ultrasonic testing of polymer composite materials by the shadow method system is described. The results of testing various samples and types of detected defects are presented. The spectra of the signal and noise are calculated by discrete Fourier transforming. Frequency separation method is used for noise filtration, signal-component separation and for calculation of signal envelope.

Author Keywords: discrete Fourier transforming. method of frequency separation

articleTitle: Design Procedure of Static Characteristics of the Resonant Converters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article is devoted to the develop of the design procedure static mode characteristics of the resonant converters power circuits. Here the idealized converters with a serial resonant circuit with various combinations of connected voltage sources are used for the analysis. The core of the proposed design procedure assumes the superimposing the current components of the converter resonant circuit caused by each voltage source separately. As shown in the article, the procedure allows obtaining expressions for calculating the stationary current of the converter circuit. Using the obtained expressions, the static characteristics of the resonant converter with two voltage sources connected to the resonant circuit are calculated.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Competition Modeling of Generations and Consumers in the New Market Structure based on the Supply Function Equilibrium Model Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Today, incentive policies have been proposed to contribute to small consumers in the market to improve network security. In this paper, the simultaneous competition of small consumers in the form of independent firms and power plants in the new market structure is modeled and the impact of competition of these firms on the behavior of generation firms and network costs is investigated. Given the multiplicity of consumer presence in this market and the rumor that this may slow down the market settlement process, the effect of imposing restrictions on a strategy change for all participants has been investigated.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Requirements to the Accuracy of Diffractively Reflecting Coatings Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: One of the main problems of modern laser alarm systems is appearance of false alarms in difficult weather conditions (fog, rain, snow) because of reduction of the environment transparency. A promising solution is creation of “laser barriers” with the help of diffractively reflecting coatings as reflective elements. But the properties of those coatings depend considerably on the manufacturing process. If a coating was produced with errors, the coherent component of the total power reflected from a diffractively reflecting coating could decrease and the diffuse component (arising due to scattering by roughness) increase. Besides, the coating could scatter power in directions that do not correspond to the directions of the diffraction maxima. The presented paper substantiates the requirements to the accuracy of diffractively reflecting coatings manufacturing on the basis of analysis of the angular distribution functions of the reflected power.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence of Number of Sensors on Accuracy of Radio Source Position Determination Based on TDOA-, RSS- and AOA- Measurements
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The graphs of isolines family are built that characterize the accuracy of determining of the radio source location based on TDOA-, RSS- and AOA-measurements of the sensor network. Two configurations of a sensor network with a different number of sensors located evenly on a circle are considered. The first configuration of the sensor network contains the minimum number of sensors, which ensures the operability of the methods. The second configuration of the sensor network provides the same accuracy in determining the radio source location at a given range in any direction. The analysis of the accuracy of determining of the radio source location is carried out with the combined use of TDOA- RSS-and AOA-measurements of the sensor network.

articleTitle: Electromechanical Tracking System Based on a Fuzzy Position Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We propose the structure of a tracking electric drive with an adaptive fuzzy position controller. The computer Simulink model of a tracking triple-loop electromechanical system with an adaptive fuzzy position controller is designed. The transients for different control signals in tracking modes are provided. The indices of dynamics of an automatic tracking under different stochastic characteristics of an input position control are studied. The studies of the tracking dynamics have been held for a proportional and a proposed adaptive fuzzy position controller. The comparative analysis of the obtained quality indices demonstrated that the proposed position controller allows to implement optimal without overshoots or dragging modes laws of motion and to decrease the dynamic error in the tracking modes. The developed solutions allow increasing the accuracy and robustness of precision tracking electric drives of the positioning and tracking complexes.

articleTitle: Direction Finding Accuracy for Ropucha-Class Landing Ship in Sighting along Missile Flight Trajectory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: the method that allows to calculate the direction finding errors for radar objects with complex shape is proposed for case that direction-finder is placed in near zone of scatterer with huge electric sizes. It is shown that main reason for errors is amplitude-phase field distribution distortions in aperture of received antenna. For all that the angle distortions increase with reducing distance to object and can be significant. At the modern stage the radar equipment development is defined by general direction to increase accuracy of object parameters determination. In the case when object dimensions are bigger than sounding signal wavelength it is possibility to account the spatial greatness of complex shape real radar targets: aircrafts, ships, cars. Thus for series of radar problem it is necessary to have a priopi information about behavior of scattered electromagnetic field in the near zone of such objects.

articleTitle: Contribution of Yuzhnoye SDO to the Creation of Rocket and Space Technology under the Leadership of S. M. Koniukhov
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article examines the contribution of the Yuzhnoye State Design Office (SDO) in the development of the rocket and space industry in Ukraine and all over the world under the leadership of a prominent scientist and engineer, academician of the NAS of Ukraine, General Designer General Director of Yuzhnoye SDO, Hero of Ukraine S. M. Koniukhov in 1990 2010. It is shown that due to the participation of S. Koniukhov and his colleagues in solving many scientific and technical problems of missile technology were made numerous inventions, which formed the basis of native and world rocketry. The article highlights the features of design and engineering developments of the team led by the scientist to create a Zenit space rocket complex (SRC), Zenit-2 and other launch vehicles (LV). The main solved scientific and technical questions concerning features of design, characteristics of ballistic maintenance, dynamics of start and transient processes, aerodynamics, a choice of pollution reduction measures in space are characterized. It is shown how the obtained results ensured the successful practical implementation of the international space programs “Sea Launch” and “Land Launch” and the realization of the National Space Programs of Ukraine. Using technologies for the RS-20 intercontinental ballistic missile (IBM) as a part of Dnepr 1 SRC contributed to the launch of spacecraft are described. It is underlined which scientific inventions concerning ballistic, dynamic and aerogas-dynamic characteristics, norms of strength, loading and temperature regimes were used in the development of experimental base and metrological support of Cyclone-3 space rockets (SR) and Cyclone-4 SR. Publication of the results concerning performed study will promote the development of historical biographies of scientists, engineers and organizers of Ukrainian science, as well as its popularization and native scientists in the world.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Accuracy of the Base of the Object of Manipulation of Bernoulli Gripping Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Providing the necessary accuracy of basing Bernoulli gripping manipulation objects in robotic cells is an relevant task and can be achieved by choosing rational parameters of the handling process. The article presents the results of experimental studies of Bernoulli gripping devices of industrial robots at various operating parameters and weight of objects of manipulation. The maximum basing error of the manipulation object in relation to the gripping devices in the operation of the technical cells has been determined. When gripping objects from a distance of 0.5…1 mm average basing error value will be 0.08…0.15 mm, with a mean quadratic deviation of 0.025…0.035 mm. At displacements of center of mass of captured objects relative to Bernoulli gripping device axis up to 20 mm maximum error of objects basing increases by 2.2 times.

articleTitle: Measurement of Diameter, Color Characteristics and Complex Refractive Index of Thin Fibers by Computer Analysis of Colors in an Image
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: When solving scientific, technical, biological and medical problems, in mathematical modeling of the processes of interaction of electromagnetic radiation with matter, it is necessary to know the physical parameters of the research object. In science and technology, these are the properties of substances that are being investigated, in medicine and biology - the parameters of muscle and bone tissues, in cosmetology - the physical properties of hair (diameter, density, heat capacity, thermal conductivity, optical parameters). Existing chemical methods make it possible to determine all these parameters, but, as a rule, with a large expenditure of time and resources. Therefore, it is urgent to develop faster physical methods of analysis without the use of chemical reactions. Great opportunities for this have appeared after the development of computer methods for modeling and processing experimental data. The paper deals with computer methods for processing images of natural thin fibers for measuring their diameter, determining optical parameters such as absorption spectrum, refractive index, attenuation index. We used the capabilities of mathematical computer programs to make a colorimetric analysis of color images, separating them into three basic color components: red, green, blue.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Pulsed Electromagnetic Field of Current Near Conducting Half-Space
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The analytical solution of the three-dimensional quasi-stationary electromagnetic field problem for current pulse near conducting body with a flat surface is used. The exact and approximate solution of the problem is presented. The exact solution has no restrictions on the external field configuration, electrophysical properties of the medium, and frequency. The approximate solution is based on an expansion in asymptotic series and is limited by the initial time interval of the pulse current. Based on a comparison of the calculation results, the proposed choice of a limited time interval for calculating the pulsed field using the asymptotic method is justified.

articleTitle: Development of Broadband Criterion for Spatially Distributed Radio Systems Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: An example for designing radio systems with aperture synthesis is given. Considerable attention was paid to the study of the ambiguity functions in such systems and the region of their spatial spectral sensitivity. A new criterion for the broadband radars with spatially distributed antenna systems is proposed. This criterion, in contrast to the existing ones, takes into account the specificities of the antenna system geometry and the operating frequency range of the radar.

articleTitle: Enhanced Directionality of Emission of the On-Threshold Modes of a High Refractive Index Microdisk Laser Due to a Small Piercing Hole
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We study, using the integral-equation-based in-house guaranteed-convergence numerical code, the effect of a circular air hole on the frequency, threshold gain and directionality of emission of the whispering-gallery modes of a two-dimensional model of circular-disk microcavity laser. We show that a small hole can enhance the directionality greatly and leave the threshold gain intact, if disk's refractive index is large enough and hole's location is chosen properly. This location should be close to the area where the same uniform disk, if illuminated with a plane wave, displays a broadband focusing in the form of hot spot called photonic jet.

articleTitle: Training of the Future Nanoscale Engineers: Methods for Selecting Efficient Solutions in the Nanostructures Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article examines modern approaches to training future nanoscale engineers, in particular the method of analyzing hierarchies for selecting efficient solutions to problems and constructive and technological ways to introduce innovations. Such an example is important for the formation of students' one of the key professional competencies of future nanotechnologists, i.e. the possession of methods for selecting efficient solutions for the effective synthesis of innovative samples of high-quality nanostructures.

articleTitle: Effect Changing of Nanopore Volumes in MgAl2O3 Ceramics under the Influence of Water
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The influence of adsorbed water on the change of free volume and nanopores in the MgAl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> ceramics sintered at 1100 °C for 2 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$h$</tex> been studied using positron annihilation lifetime method. It is shown that after immersion of ceramics in water the positron and ortho-positronium trapping occurs more intensely. After drying of ceramic part of the water remains, as evidenced by the parameters of the third component of the annihilation spectrum. It has been established that adsorption processes in MgAl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> ceramics lead to the fragmentation of nanopores, while desorption causes their agglomeration

articleTitle: Improving the Information Security of Modern Telecommunications Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The main characteristics of fiber-optic networks for which you can keep statistics, predict losses in signal propagation by communication lines, establish the presence of unauthorized access to the network are the power of the optical signal at the transmitter output and receiver input, respectively, and bit error rate. Its value is defined as the ratio of error-decoded bits to the total number of bits transmitted. According to the specified characteristics it is possible. Existing methods prevent the main methods of ND to optical fiber, but are characterized by low accuracy of establishing the location of unauthorized connection in fiber-optic communication lines. The proposed method of control of fiber-optic communication lines is based on the simultaneous use of hardware and software, which allows to increase the protection of information flows through additional processing of information signals transmitted in fiber-optic communication lines and increase the reliability and accuracy of location unauthorized access to optical channels. This argument confirms the timeliness and relevance of the scientific and practical problem, the solution of which requires the development of methods and practical provisions for the construction of means of control of unauthorized access in fiber-optic communication lines.

articleTitle: The Optimization of PV-plant's DC/AC Equipment Ratio Using the Non-linear Least-cost Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The optimal ratio of direct and alternating current (DC and AC, respectively) power for photovoltaic (PV) power plants equipment was determined using the improved non-linear least-cost model to optimize the structure of equipment. DC/AC ratio 1.59 was calculated on the criteria of minimization of the levelized daily cost of electricity according to the annual hourly PV power plants capacity of Ukraine's Integrated Electricity System (IES). The implementation of PV power plant with a certain optimal structure of equipment will reduce the levelized cost of electricity production during its life cycle by 4.2% compared to the initial DC/AC ratio at 1.2. Evaluation of results carried out through the calculation of the levelized cost of electricity during operating life confirmed the reliability of the results obtained using a non-linear mathematical model.

articleTitle: Measurements of the Cubic Anisotropy Field in the (111) Thin Magnetic Films
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The report presents the complete description of the suggested experimental method for the determination of the cubic anisotropy field value in the thin magnetic film samples grown on the (111) plane. It is based on the measurements of ferromagnetic resonance frequency for the two specified directions of the bias magnetic field. A theoretical discussion is given which justify the expressions for the ferromagnetic resonance frequency for those directions as well as a method for the evaluation of the cubic anisotropy field. A measured experimental data are presented for the non-substituted yttrium-iron garnet film together with the calculated values of the anisotropy field.

articleTitle: Frequencies and Thresholds of Transversal Plasmon Modes of the Laser Shaped as a Circular Quantum Wire Wrapped in Graphene Cover
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We use the Lasing Eigenvalue Problem (LEP) approach to study the source-free problem of the electromagnetic field in the presence of a circular quantum wire (QW) wrapped in graphene cover. Our instrument is the method of separation of variables and the Kubo formalism for the graphene conductivity. We analyze the lasing conditions for the plasmon modes of such a laser with microsize and nanosize QW diameters. We find eigenvalue pairs, i.e. the frequencies and the threshold values of the QW gain index for several plasmon modes and investigate their dependences on the QW and graphene parameters.

articleTitle: Combline Bandpass Filter with Asymmetric Frequency Response and Extended Stopband
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)

This bandpass filter (BPF) uses a mixed coupling coefficient K = Km + K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</inf> between quarter-wave (λ/4) resonators. This coupling contains magnetic Km and electrical K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</inf> components. Appropriate selection of Km and K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</inf> components allows us to adjust the TZ position at real frequencies for a given value of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$K$</tex> (for a given bandwidth). The TZ f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">z</inf> can be located on different sides of the bandwidth central frequency <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f$</tex><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>.
