They are connected to the resonators at certain points, which provides the filter with an extended stopband. The experimental data of the second-order microstrip BPF, the stopband of which is characterized by the ratio of boundary frequencies f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> = 6.6 at an attenuation level of 25 dB, are presented.

articleTitle: Development of Piezoresistive Materials Based on Elastic Polyurethanes and Carbon Nanotubes for Sensor Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The research of features of electrical conductivity of polyurethane nanocomposite materials, filled with multiwalled carbon nanotubes depending on pressure is done using the impedance spectroscopy method. The conductivity dependences of the systems based on polyurethane and multiwalled carbon nanotubes from the applied external pressure are received, and these dependences are also modelled in the frame of the scaling approach and the percolating theory. It is shown that the probed systems are perspective and can be used as piezoresistive materials for sensors of pressure. It was shown, that sensor, which contains 3 % nanotubes, demonstrates the greatest speed of reacting and sensitiveness.

articleTitle: Shaft Run-Out Optical Remote Sensing System For Large Generator Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper a present optical noncontact displacement sensing system for diagnosing shaft run-out of large hydro generator is considered. This system is designed to realize early detection and localization of process malfunctions during normal operation or during scheduled maintenance of a hydrogenerator. The design and measurement principle of the information measuring channel with optical remote sensing generator is considered. This transducer designed for control mechanical parameters as shaft run-out and can be used large hydro generator fault diagnostic system. A block diagram of an optical remote sensing was proposed. Position of the optical sensing element and data acquisition tools of the optical remote sensing system on the generator was shown. The principle and method of measurement value of the shaft run-out was described.

articleTitle: High-Power Impulses with Nanosecond Fronts Obtaining Using Forming Lines on Nonlinear Electronic Elements
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Usage of circuits for obtaining of the high voltage impulses with a rise time of the order of a few nanoseconds in a low impedance load has been described. For this, the all-solid state forming lines consisting of arrays of the multilayer ceramic capacitors on X7R type ferroelectric were used. For such forming lines elaboration non-linear properties of the X7R ferroelectric were investigated. Carried measurements have shown that an experimental forming line consisting of an array of 200 X7R SMD MLCCs with length 0.25 m provides reduction of the front duration of the voltage impulse with the amplitude of about 2 kV from 120 ns to 5 ns in a low resistive load (1 Ω and less). Representation of such a forming line as a 3D meta-medium having the equivalent rank-2 tensor permittivity and permeability enables mathematical modelling of the electromagnetic impulses propagation.

articleTitle: Determination of Technical Condition of the Power Transformer by Frequency Response Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In 10 kV electrical distribution networks, many power transformers have been in operation for more than 25 years, which exceeds their passport life and in conditions of rapid growth of power generated by photovoltaic stations can cause a decrease in the reliability of these networks. Therefore, it is necessary to improve the quality of modern means of determining the technical condition of such transformers. It is proposed to determine the defective node of the transformer by comparing the current frequency response of the studied transformer with the sample, which is obtained by averaging the values of the frequency characteristics of other transformers, the same type with the test.

articleTitle: Formation of an Optimal Trajectory for Controlling the Active Power of an Electric Arc Furnace
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article describes the principles of forming an optimal trajectory for controlling the active power of an electric arc furnace (EAF). Thereat, a complex synergetic model of the melting process has been used, and a rational material and energy balance of the unit has been drawn up. The use of the obtained trajectory, along with creating an automated control system for the EAF operation, allows you to achieve energy savings by 13-14% while maintaining the quality of the smelted products.

articleTitle: Operator Method in Approximate Solution of Dielectric Waveguide Eigenwaves Scattering by Graphene Strips
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Approximate solution of a dielectric waveguide eigenwaves scattering by finite and semi-infinite system of graphene strips is presented. The operator method is used. We suppose that only waveguide eigenwaves can exist in the domain between the strips. Under this approximation integral operator equations become matrix ones. Their solution requires much less computation time. The solution of the co-called key problem, the scattering problem by a single graphene strip inside a dielectric slab, is obtained by the method of singular integral equations. The frequency dependences of scattering characteristics as well as radiation patterns are presented.

articleTitle: Two-Point Probability Functions and Correlation Properties of the Generalized Additive High-Order Markov Chains
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The aim of this work is to study statistical properties of the finite state Markov chains of the Nth order which have a vast area of applications as modeling and algorithmic tools in computer science, communication and network system analysis and development, risk management and decision making problems, etc. The transition probability matrix of the chain is assumed to be homogeneous and additive, with arbitrary form of memory functions. We obtain analytical solutions for the stationary probability distribution vector and for the correlation matrix and, thus, for the two-point probability distribution functions of the chain.

articleTitle: Wideband Diffraction Properties of Azimutally Symmetric Grating with Different Geometry
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Today vector beams with special polarization properties are used in many branches of science and technology. One of the ways for forming such beams is using laser cavities equipped by diffraction grating in order to select electromagnetic modes with the desirable polarization of the field. Conscious using such grating is impossible without detail investigation of their diffraction properties for different geometrical constructions and for different frequencies of the incident field. In this paper we are going to provide such investigations for different types of the gratings. Some physical phenomena of the wave beams diffraction in a hollow dielectric waveguide with azimuthal grating are found and explained.

articleTitle: The Features of the Active Battery Balancing Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper provides an overview of the existing circuit solutions of balancing devices for storage batteries. The principle of balancing based on a capacitive and inductive buffer element is described. The features of their work and the main calculated dependencies of each of the types of devices are shown. For circuits with transformer topology, the calculated values are indicated to determine the balancing current. Based on the analysis of circuit solutions, the effectiveness of the use of circuit solutions based on inductive buffer elements is numerically determined and proved.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Electrical Networks Functioning Quality of with Photovoltaic Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The impact of installed photovoltaic power plants in power grids on power quality is presented. Classification of indicators that characterize the quality of electricity supply is proposed. Supply power quality consists of three groups indexes, the first group is the assessment of the reliability level, the second is the quality of service provision, third is the quality of electric energy. System average interruption duration index (SAIDI) and energy not supplied (ENS) are shown for the Ukrainian power system during the last 5 years. The article analyzes the experimental data obtained for 10/0,4 kV Ukrainian electrical networks, which are characterized by a high level of integration of photovoltaic power plants.

articleTitle: Traction Substation Transformer Power Distribution Investigation Under Asymmetric and Nonlinear Loading Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article deals with the study of power distribution in the traction transformer that feeds the railway transport quarry network. The equivalent scheme of the traction transformer according to the deduced power balance equations is constructed. The analysis of power distribution calculation methods in the transformer is carried out. According to the known method of determining the power distribution in the traction transformer, based on the array of data taken from the traction substation transformer of the mining and processing plant, calculations of energy processes in the transformer. The energy indicators data of traction transformer primary and secondary windings are obtained. When analyzing the above results, it is noted that the power vector of the phases of the primary and secondary windings do not match, this may indicate a redistribution of power in the transformer.

articleTitle: Modular Multiplier for Digital Quantum Coprocessor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article continues research on the creation of digital quantum coprocessors. A quantum computer has a heterogeneous structure. The quantum (probabilistic) part of a quantum computer is considered as a coprocessor in relation to a classical computer (as its accelerator). The digital quantum coprocessor itself has a heterogeneous structure. It consists of a probabilistic part, which implements the actual quantum computations, and a digital part, which performs complex mathematical calculations necessary for the implementation of quantum algorithms. Organization of modular multiplication and exponentiation, which is used in Shor's algorithm, is discussed in this article. It is proposed to perform modular multiplication and exponentiation using well-known logic circuits, namely, sequential multi-bit multipliers. The structure of a serial modular multiplier and its components is considered. The technical characteristics of the components of the modular multiplier are presented. Further work is outlined in the direction of creating a modular multiplier for implementing Shor's algorithm in a digital quantum coprocessor.

articleTitle: The Annealing Effect on the Structure and Microstructure of Three-Dimensional Printed Zinc Oxide Films
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this work, ZnO films were obtained on glass by printing inks containing nanocrystals synthesized by the polyol method. ZnO films were annealed at (200–400) °C for 60 min in air and vacuum. The structural and microstructural properties of the deposited layers were investigated by X-ray diffraction. It allowed to study the effect of the temperature of post-growth annealing and the environment on the lattice parameters, the size of the coherent scattering (CSR) regions, and the level of microdeformations in the oxide samples. Annealing conditions were determined to provide ZnO films with properties suitable for use in electronic microdevices.

articleTitle: Influence of Technological Features of Formation of Humidity-sensitive Thick-film Structures on Their Functionality
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Humidity-sensitive thick-film structures based on MgAl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> ceramics for sensor electronics have been prepared. Two methods of forming contact areas are demonstrated: using Ag or Ag-Ru paste and conductive thermistor ceramic thick films. It is established that the obtained thick-film structures are characterized by sensitivity at the maximum range of relative humidity. It is shown that thick films formed on Ag-Ru contacts lose their sensitivity after natural physical aging due to degradation of the contact area. Functionality can be restored after re-formation of contacts. The change in resistance in thick films with applied contacts in the form of a thermistor film is one order of magnitude.

articleTitle: Distributed Inductance Printed Antennas
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper considers the influence of an inductive element on the characteristics of a printed emitter. The inductive element is realized in the form of a short-circuited fragment of a coplanar waveguide. The distributed inductance of 10, 15 and 20 mm lengths were investigated in the ranges of 860-1000 MHz. The element in form of the slot allows to reduce the size of the antenna, adjust its resonant frequency and reduce interference from high-frequency sources. The results can be used in telecommunication systems and for the development of miniature antennas as a means of transmitting signals from devices to computer systems.

articleTitle: Binary Space Topology Features in Applying to Transitional States Generation of Asynchronous Finite State Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Several features of n-dimensional binary space topology are considered in the paper. A number of special rules for encoding the signatures of state-transition diagram of FSM according to the binary space features have been formulated. The asynchronous FSM encoding algorithm, according the described rules is implemented as a software module. The algorithm that generating additional transitional states sequences is in accordance with “differs exactly one bit state” switching condition is described in details. Evaluation subsequent with the comparative analysis of obtained encoding results is also presented.

articleTitle: Parameters Identification for Self-Commissioning of DC-DC Boost Converters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A new algorithm for self-commissioning procedure of DC-DC boost converters is presented. It is based on closed-loop adaptive observer of the converter model in average coordinates and provides identification of parameters namely: resistance and inductance of input inductor and DC-link capacitance. The rigorous proof of stability for physical operating conditions is given based on second Lyapunov method. Simulation results show fast convergence of the estimation errors.

articleTitle: Mechanisms of Structural Degradation of Oxymanganospinel Ceramics for Active Elements of Temperature Sensors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The mechanisms of thermodegradation of temperature-sensitive elements on the example of two-phase Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.l</inf>Ni<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</inf>Co<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</inf>Mn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.9</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> ceramics sintered at 1170 °C and subjected to additional heat treatment at 850 °C are considered. It is shown that the processes of additional separation of the second phase continue during thermal exposure at temperatures of 125 °C and 170 °C. The observed changes indicate the release of additional phases at the grain boundaries, which leads to an increase in the relative resistance of the ceramic. It is established that higher degradation temperature leads to more significant changes in electrical resistance. It is shown that additional temperature influences contribute to the stabilization of ceramic parameters. The degradation test at 170 °C causes a decrease in electrical resistance by 7.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, while at 125 °C the resistance drift is only 6%.

articleTitle: GPR Data Processing Using the Synthesized Pulse Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper presents an additional method of correction pulse signal characteristics in ground penetrating radar (GPR) data processing. Improving the methods of GPR signal processing is the important problem connected to the possibilities of non-destructive testing of localized as well as extended objects like motor roads. The relevance of such task is associated with the need to optimize maintenance and repair activities in conditions of limited funding. The proposed correction increases the reliability of processing and accuracy of restoring the properties of probed objects in the process of solving thickness measurement problems. The proposed method additionally is based on the use of combined correction of the original real pulse signal in order to remove signals which re-reflected from the metal sheet and other close items during the calibration process. Thus, the shape of the sounding pulse becomes as close as possible to the shape of the ideal probing signal, which ultimately contributes to an increase in the quality and accuracy of GPR data processing.

articleTitle: Operator Method in the E-Polarized Plane Wave Scattering by Coplanar Half-Plane and Disk: Basic Equations and Convergence
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The scattering of the E-polarized wave by the system which consists of a half-plane and a disk is considered. The operator method is used. Basic equations are presented and their discretization is discussed. The numerical convergence is studied.

articleTitle: Basic Equations of the Lasing Eigenvalue Problem for Graphene Strips-on-Substrate Grating, H-Polarization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We consider the H-polarized lasing modes of an infinite flat grating of graphene monolayer strips, patterned on top of a dielectric-slab substrate. The electron conductivity of graphene is modeled using the Kubo formulas. The material of the substrate is assumed to possess the gain, which compensates for the radiation and ohmic losses, so that the modes are at the threshold of lasing. The eigenvalues of this problem are the pairs of real-valued numbers: the frequency and the threshold value of the gain index, specific for each mode. To find them, we reduce this problem to a dual series equation for the complex amplitudes of the Floquet spatial harmonics. Then we perform analytical regularization of this equation, based on the inversion of its static part. This yields a Fredholm second-kind infinite matrix equation and the associated determinantal equation for the eigenvalues, convergence of which to the exact values is guaranteed with larger truncation numbers. We can see that both the frequency and the threshold gain values of the lasing modes can be controlled by the variation of the graphene parameters.

articleTitle: Optical Properties and Field Distribution of Spherical Copper Monosulfide Particles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this work, the spectral characteristics of large-size copper monosulfide particles (radius of 100, 125, and 150 nm) were studied in detail. Calculations of the optical response of copper monosulfide particles were carried out by the finite element method. Distribution of the electric field and its intensity in the dipole approximation for spherical CuS particles have been simulated. The distribution of the electromagnetic field around copper monosulfide particles was compared with gold particles of 100 and 125 nm in size. It is shown that concentration of free carrier in the copper monosulfide particles is higher in comparison to the gold ones in the case of large particles.

articleTitle: Modeling the Process of Loading Impact on Web Servers in Computer Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article studies the process of loading a web server in computer systems. Based on the Queueing Theory metrics, the main characteristics of a web server's performance are obtained. The paper shows the features of using the most common libraries for modeling computational processes based on R-programming. The work also developed a software environment for supporting the study of load impact and shows individual fragments of the benchmark source code (scheduler and executor module) written in the high-level Java language. The described example of the source code of the research script provided various intervals of loading a web server in a computer system. As a result of generators' use for triangular and uniform distributions of random variables, the load's influence on the web servers was simulated. The article also provides a comparative characteristic of estimates for modeling the loading impact on web servers in computer systems using triangular and uniform distributions of random variables.

Author Keywords: the process of loading a web server in computer systems
a scenario for carrying out a study of loading impact

articleTitle: Development of Neural Network for Cyclohexane Oxidation Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: An intelligent system for processing data of liquid-phase oxidation reactions for an industrial method of obtaining valuable oxygen-containing compounds has been developed. The scheme is based on a multilayer artificial neural network for digital signal processing. Clear simulations on the effect of the initial concentration of cyclohexane hydroperoxide, cyclohexanol, cyclohexanone, acids, and esters on the catalysis reaction were obtained and analyzed for different catalysts by the means of an artificial neural network. The neural network, after training, accurately reproduces the studied data from a sample of experiments and predicts the result of the study in extended time ranges and concentrations of catalytic impurities. The obtained predictions allow experimenters to select the most promising direction during the determination for the concentration of active catalytic substances.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Metrological Characteristics of Biomedical Temperature Sensors Based on Transistor Structures
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The analysis of metrological characteristics of biomedical temperature sensors based on transistor structures is carried out. It showed that the nonlinearity of the transfer function of the transistor-based primary transducer has the greatest influence on the measurement accuracy. We have proposed a linearization method based on the use of a multiplication device which forms compensatory voltage proportional to the quadratic component of the transfer function of the transistor-based primary transducer. This allowed to reduce the temperature measurement error up to ± 0.5·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>°C over the temperature ranges 0… 80°C and up to ± 1·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>°C over the temperature range 0… 100°C. In order to increase the accuracy of temperature measurement, an additional circuit for compensating the nonlinearity of the transfer function of a transistor-based primary transducer has been developed. It forms a quadratic voltage component proportional to the difference between the measured temperature and the temperature at the starting point of the second linearization range. The temperature measurement error does not exceed ± 0.39·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>°C over the temperature range 0…100 °C.

articleTitle: Photoelectrical Properties of the CU2O/CdTe Heterostructure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The photoelectrical properties of the p-Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O/n-CdTe heterostructure obtained on the basis of Cu2o thin films were investigated. In work also describes the Cu2o thin films growth conditions and its influence on the optical and electrical properties. By the method of RF magnetron sputtering Cu2o thin films were obtained. A target from copper oxide II powder was used. Films sputtered on glass and glass-ceramic substrates. Obtained P-Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O films were with: optical band gap - E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">op</sup>= 2.6 eV, specific resistance - p = 0.5 Ω× cm. Investigation of the I-V-characteristics of p-Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O/n-CdTe heterostructures showed that the heterostructures have a pronounced rectifying effect with a rectification coefficient RR ~ 240 at a voltage of 3 V, the potential barrier height eφ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</inf> = 2.1 e V at T = 300 K. The series resistance of the heterostructures reaches R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</inf> ~ 6.4 Ω at room temperature and is formed by the n-CdTe substrates and decreases with the light irradiation.

articleTitle: Study of Microwave Absorption in Foam Structures Using Microstrip Cells
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The propagation of electromagnetic waves with a frequency of 1810 MHz in foam structures of various foaming ratio, made on the basis of salt solutions of water is considered. A microstrip cell and an experimental setup for studying the amplitude and phase characteristics of a transmitted wave through moving foam samples through a microstrip measuring cell are described. The measurements were carried out in a wide range of foaming ratio 40–200 and salt additive concentrations of 0-15%.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of Online Transaction Processing System for Design of Building Territory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This study is devoted to the problem of the ability to represent multidimensional design of building territory based on Online Analytical Processing (OLAP) technology. Building territory is viewed as complex information system, which relate with other information systems of surrounding areas. Mathematical modeling of such information system for multidimensional design based on OLAP technology is proposed to solve this problem. It is proposed to use a Online Transaction Processing (OLTP) system for multidimensional analysis and design of the two subject areas. The first subject area contains background information about the topography, geodesy and geology of the building territory. The second subject area contains information about the surrounding areas to the building territory. OLAP cubes represent multidimensional information objects with associated properties. Each OLTP system is an implementation of a domain model and is designed by a multidimensional matrix, which is represented as an OLAP cube. The application of this concept in a Web-based environment is covered.

articleTitle: Impulse Processes in the System of Electrodynamic Treatment of Welds
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: On the basis of the developed analytical mathematical model non-stationary process of electrodynamic treatment of welds and estimation of the main dynamic, electro-physical and thermal characteristics of the process are considered. The characteristics of the motion of the electrodes, the distribution of the pulse current in the metal plate, the heating of the metal are found and analyzed. The conclusion about the possibility of realization of devices with simultaneous supply of current pulses of necessary parameters on the shock electromagnetic element and through an electrode to the metal plate is made.

articleTitle: Study of a Hybrid Photovoltaic Solar Station with High-Voltage Converters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In the article analytical and field test of the experimental photovoltaic station equipped with hybrid photovoltaic module equipped and innovative power take-off system with DC-DC converters was carried out. It was established that the power take-off system with DC-DC converters working with hybrid photovoltaic modules has an efficiency up to 92.5 % in a wide range of solar radiation intensity, and was confirmed reliability and effective working of hybrid photovoltaic modules innovative components. It has been shown that experimental sample of the optimized photovoltaic station with a low concentration of solar radiation can generate in stable mode values of electric power on a level of 14 kW.

articleTitle: Transient Analysis in Three-Phase Cable Lines with the Transposition Phase Cables Conductive Screens During Short Circuit Fault
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: To solve an urgent scientific problem and apply the multipole theory, the method for calculating transient electromagnetic processes in three-phase cable power lines was improved, taking into account the induced EMF of mutual induction. On the example of a single-phase short circuit in a three-phase high-voltage cable line, a technique has been implemented that provides the determination of the features of the flow of transient processes in three-phase cable lines with the specification of the quantitative characteristics of these processes. The aim of the work is to develop methods for analyzing transient processes in a single-phase short circuit in three-phase circuits with distributed parameters and phase-to-phase connections based on the representation of such electrical circuits by multiport network. The performed studies have shown that when compiling physical models and when modeling with the help of special computer programs for calculating transient processes, it is advisable to use chain equivalent circuits of a circuit with distributed parameters.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Influence of Smart Grid Users in Smart City on the Operation of a Single-Phase Distribution Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: When considering the new standards of a smart city and its power systems, special focus is given to the power transformer and its control and monitoring systems as well as load management. After all, at the moment this link is most vulnerable to the factors of influence on the part of the energy source and its quality on the one hand and reasonable consumers of electricity on the other. As a result of working with the increasing load of components of a smart city, the probability of critical damage to the transformer and even its failure increases. Recent research is mostly based on the analysis of the spectral influence of current and voltage of smart network consumers on the distribution transformer. The order of definition of components of active and reactive power of the distributive transformer in the loading mode taking into account influence of nonlinear consumers of Smart Grid is offered as indicators of the state of the transformer winding. On the laboratory equipment performed modeling of the influence of Smart Grid users on the operation of a single-phase distribution transformer. The primary sequence of the experiment to study the energy performance of the distribution transformer in the mode of loading by nonlinear Smart Grid consumers has been developed. For this purpose, a model of a distribution transformer was built and the indicators of the harmonic spectra of the active and reactive power of the controlled windings were determined for all harmonics to be determined. The influence of DG on the harmonic power spectrum and its negative influence on the manifestation of harmonic monitors of components, namely harmonic components of 6th and 8th orders, is noted. The results of the study can be used as a tool that can serve as a mathematical assessment of the system of calculation and development of fault monitors based on the spectrally analyzed flow of power, current and voltage.

articleTitle: Research of Dispersed Media Optical Properties by Photothermal Interference Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper presents the study of optical properties of absorbing and scattering media. In order to determine changes in the optical properties of the studied media using the photothermal interference method, the digital interferometer scheme and related software were developed. It is shown that the developed photothermal interference method is characterized by high sensitivity and can be successfully used for rapid, non-contact, non-destructive determination of the parameters of absorbing and scattering media.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Mathematical Model of Low-Frequency Electromagnetic Processes of Power Transformer using MATLAB/Simulink
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The mathematical model of analysis of low-frequency electromagnetic transient in three-phase two-winding transformers in the MATLAB/Simulink modeling environment has been improved. The model adequately takes into account the electromagnetic connections between the windings and the magnetic circuit of the transformer, their electromagnetic parameters, the nonlinearity of the Weber-ampere characteristics of the magnetic circuit elements and power loss from hysteresis and eddy currents.

articleTitle: Sensorless Speed Control of the Surface Mounted Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A new sensorless speed control algorithm for surface mounted permanent magnet synchronous motors is presented. State observer is designed for speed and position estimation, and its stability is proved using the second Lyapunov method. If vector control algorithm is used for speed control, observer can be slightly modified to achieve the controller performance that is suitable for high dynamic applications. The effectiveness of designed sensorless speed control algorithm is demonstrated by simulations.

articleTitle: Advanced Heat Transfer Model of PV/T System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The main aim of proposed research is to consider a method for increasing the efficiency and the lifetime of photovoltaic systems. This article briefly presents theoretical methods for increasing the efficiency of such systems, as well as increasing the service life, by simulating the cooling parameters of the absorber surface of such systems and tracking the maximum power. Modeling and the obtained theoretical model will allow in the future selecting the most suitable technical solutions to maximize the energy output of photovoltaic systems for various design solutions.

articleTitle: Search for the Ways of Implementation of the Hybrid Method for Obtaining Hardening Composite Coating with Onion-like Carbon and Metal Carbides during Electrical Conductors Explosion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The ways of implementation of the electric-discharge hybrid method of nanostructured metal-carbon coatings with onion-like carbon synthesis, which combines the continuous high-frequency electric discharge in carbon-containing gases and electric explosion of metal conductors, are analyzed. Four technological diagrams for this method realization are offered and their limitations are defined. New circuit solutions have been developed. They actualize the hybrid method of composite metal-carbon coatings with onionlike nanocarbon synthesis using the controlled mobile plasma switch of the high-frequency discharge current, which shorts the discharge circuit of the pulse current generator and causes the explosion of the metal conductor.

articleTitle: Plasma Electrolytic Oxidation of Al: Structure and Properties of Coatings
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The coatings consisting of different transition modifications of aluminum oxide were obtained by the aluminum substrate using the plasma electrolytic oxidation method. Optical, electron microscopy and sub-THz quasioptical ellipsometry were used for coatings properties studying. Also, the biological properties of coatings have been studied and show the absence of cytotoxic effect of the tested materials on bacterial and yeast cells. Preliminary experimental results are illustrated and discussed.

articleTitle: Microstrip Antenna with Complex Topology Fed by Coplanar Line
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper presents the results of numerical modeling of the spectral and energy characteristics of a microstrip antenna with slot inhomogeneities of complex topology. Simulation was carried out within the framework of a semi-open resonator model by the finite element method using the Ansoft HFSS software product. The influence of the geometric dimensions and material constants of the structure on the frequency and energy characteristics is investigated.

articleTitle: Dnieper Hydroelectric Station (DniproHES). The Story of the Largest Investment in the Electricity Industry in Europe in the Early XX Century
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In the paper the history of Dnieper Hydroelectric Station (DniproHES) is studied. The influence of the DniproHES building process on the European electricity industry is shown. The challenges faced by the chief engineer Ivan Alexandrov and construction head Aleksandr Vinter are highlighted. The unique technical practices are considered. The creation of architectural embodiment of the dam is shown.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Millimeter-Wave Magnetrons
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Specific features and problems of the design of millimeter-wave magnetrons are described. Cold secondary-emission cathode usage is considered as a promising factor for the device life prolongation. Field-emission cathodes instead of thermionic ones are proposed as the trigger units for further increase of the magnetron working life. The problems of ensuring enough frequency separation between the operating eigenmode and neighboring modes are discussed; using the rising-sun delay system and operating on spatial harmonics are proposed as possible solutions. The methods of providing enough emitting current from cathodes without their fast burnout are considered; the solution of the problem could lie in using inverted design of the magnetron. Examples of “cold” (electrodynamic) calculations of the delay systems of millimeter-wave magnetrons are given. “Hot” (electronic) simulations with PIC algorithms have been performed using TULIPgm code for magnetron and amplitron modeling.

articleTitle: Influence of Contamination with Silicone Release Agent on the Ellipsometric Parameters of CFRP Surface in the Sub-THz Range
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This work is devoted to the experimental study of the effect of contamination of CFRP plates with silicone release agents on their ellipsometric parameters, and, accordingly, the possibility of ellipsometry to diagnose such contamination. As the studied objects, three series of CFRP samples, consisting of the initial (not contaminated) and contaminated samples, were used. In total, three degrees of contamination (concentration) with silicon were investigated: 5 at.%, 10 at.%, and 20 at.%. We used a quasi-optical sub-terahertz ellipsometer with an operating wavelength of 2.14 mm. It is shown that using sub-terahertz ellipsometry it is possible to reliably determine the concentration of silicon contamination of the CFRP surface. The ellipsometric parameters that are most sensitive to such contamination are determined.

articleTitle: Gimballed Attitude and Heading Reference System for Marine Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper deals with creating a gimballed attitude and heading system assigned for operation on marine vehicles. Features of the developed system are the high precision and resistance to accelerations. The kinematical scheme of the considered system is represented. The list of operating regimes is given. The mathematical models of the considered system in the regimes of determining attitude and heading are developed. The matrix of directional cosines is represented. Simulation of both above-mentioned regimes has been carried out. The results of the simulation are represented.

articleTitle: Magnetization of the Magnetic Circuit of an Induction Motor with Massive End Ferromagnetic Screens
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article is devoted to the calculation of energy characteristics of starting modes (transient time and energy consumption) of electric drives with induction motors with massive end ferromagnetic screens of elements of the rotor circuit outside the working air gap taking into account the saturation of the magnetic circuit. A feature of such electric machines is the variation of the rotor circuit parameters depending on the value of slip. This calculation is done using an iterative procedure, thus the additional variable parameter of the equivalent circuit significantly complicates the calculation. The obtained results were compared with the calculations at a constant value of the inductive magnetization resistance. It was determined that neglecting the nonlinearity of the magnetization curve increases the calculating error of energy characteristics by an average of 7-8%, but simplifies the iterative procedure for determining the frequency-dependent parameters of the rotor circuit and increases the accuracy of their calculation

articleTitle: Electrodynamical Model of Linear Array Consisting of Inclined Semitransparent Elements
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The radiation of linear array, which consists of a set of inclined semitransparent mirrors, is studied in paper. The physical parameters of system satisfy the quasi-optical conditions. The elements of radiation system are placed in the Fresnel zone, and the receiving aperture of system is situated in a far zone relatively to its size. The explicit formulas are derived for calculation of the field values in the constituent elements of array and its radiation pattern (RP). The computations demonstrate the capacity of system to form the RPs close to the desired ones.

articleTitle: UWB Antenna Arrays with the Monopole-Slot Radiator of Clavin Type
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The UWB antenna arrays of different configurations are built on the base of UWB monopole-slot radiator of Clavin type of improved construction. Strong interaction between ultrawideband slot and two ultrawideband short-circuited monopoles permits to radiate at lower frequencies. Improved form of slot, cones, and its positions make possible to provide the better agreement of the radiator with source in a wide frequency range. Time dependences at different angles for different antenna arrays are presented.

articleTitle: Multi-Frequency Multiple Path Oblique Incidence Sounding of the Ionosphere Disturbed by Super Typhoon Motion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The aim of this study is to observe the changes in the characteristics of HF radio waves traveling through the ionosphere perturbed by the super typhoon Hagibis during October 6–13, 2019 period. The measurements have been taken with the Harbin Engineering University (the People's Republic of China) multi-frequency multiple path software defined radio system. The super typhoon acted to enhance wave activity in the atmosphere and to generate wave processes with 10 to 120-min periods. The atmospheric gravity waves have been confirmed to conduct coupling within the atmosphere-upper-atmosphere-ionosphere system. The impact on the ionosphere was the largest when the super typhoon energy was a maximum, i.e., on October 8, 10, and particularly 9, 2019, and when the typhoon was at distances of ~2,500 km to ~3,000 km from the midpoints of the propagation paths. The wave processes acted to excite oscillations in the reflection level height from 30–50 km to 60–90 km. In the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$F$</tex> region, the ~20-min period harmonic in electron density changes were seen with amplitude of 10-12%, while the ~60-120-min period harmonics with amplitudes of 30-60%.

articleTitle: Triple-Band Dipole Antenna for Wireless Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The solution of the problem concerning a thin impedance dipole with local asymmetric excitation derived in the thin-wire approximation. The design of the impedance antenna based on the optimization modeling characterized by three resonant frequencies which intended for mobile communications operating in GSM 900, GSM 1800, and WiMAX ranges is developed. Analysis of basic electrodynamic characteristics of the dipole antenna has proved the possibility of practical applications of this antenna for smartphones, electronic gadgets, and base stations.

articleTitle: Single-Mode and Multimode Operation of the Rectangular Waveguide with a Spherical Ferrite Probe
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper presents results of mathematical modeling of transmission and reflection coefficients of a rectangular waveguide with a ferrite probe for selective microwave wattmeters of multimode power. The mathematical modeling was performed for the case of three lower wave types propagating at the multimode operation of the rectangular waveguide in a frequency range of 10–16 GHz. The general equations of transmission and reflection coefficients are given. Change in the radius of the spherical ferrite probe was established not to cause changes in the reflection coefficient depending on the position of this ferrite probe in the waveguide. Only the numerical values of the curve peaks on the graph change. The larger is the radius, the greater are the reflection coefficients. The dependence of the transfer and reflection coefficients on different values of the resonance curve half-width was also investigated. The transmittance was shown to depend weakly on the constant magnetization.

articleTitle: Simple Algorithms for Antenna Array Calibration and Their Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper presents two simple algorithms, developed for the calibration of antenna arrays (AA), which do not require phase measurements. The algorithms estimate the unknown AA channel phases by means of the solution of a system of real-valued linear equations. The data, which are used in these equations, are the AA output power measurements under the perturbation of the current phase shifter state on 0°, 90° and 270° or on 0°, 90° and 180° in each calibrated channel. The paper presents the mathematical details of the proposed algorithms. The simulation results demonstrate the accuracy of the algorithms in terms of the mean square errors of the estimated channel phases and in terms of the Euclidian distance between the radiation pattern of the ideal AA and the calibrated AA, i.e. the AA whose channel phases are estimated and compensated. Additionally, this accuracy is compared to that of the simplified versions of the Rotating-Element Electric-Field Vector (REV) algorithm. The new algorithms can be used not only for the AA calibration in the anechoic chamber, but also in the field operation, providing the AA calibration and signal source tracking simultaneously.

articleTitle: Impact Ionization in Graded Gap Transferred Electron Diode
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Graded band diode structures for generation in long wave part of terahertz range are proposed. Low intensive impact ionization is used as a way to improve of frequency properties of transfer electron devices (TED). InzGa1-zAs-based graded band structures with the active region length of a 0.5 – 1.2 µm are considered. Ensemble Monte-Carlo Technique (EMC) is carried out to describe dynamics of the charge carriers in the devices. The direct current and high frequency diode characteristics are considered. Electromagnetic wave generation in frequencies up to 300 GHz have been shown. Designing problems of impact ionization-based TED are discussed. It is shown that localized impact ionization can be an energy relaxation mechanism.

articleTitle: Pagination And Its Efficient Methods For RESTful Web Services
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper on the basis of analyzed resources and accumulated IT-industry ideas we discuss the problem of the overhead of the common approaches to pagination in RESTful web services, as well as the ways of overcoming it by using a method that fuses usual approaches while covering their weaknesses.

articleTitle: Application of Affine Projection Algorithm in Adaptive Arrays
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper considers the Linearly Constrained (LC) Affine Projection (AP) adaptive filtering algorithm and its application in adaptive antenna arrays. The proposed version of the algorithm has a reduced number of computations comparing with that of the original algorithm. It is shown that the normalization matrix and its inverse, which appear in the AP algorithm, can be computed with a reduced number of arithmetic operations due to the specific structure of the matrices. The details of the algorithm development and the full computational procedure of the algorithm are presented. The algorithm efficiency is demonstrated via the simulation of the interference mitigation by means of the proposed AP algorithm in a rectangular adaptive antenna array. It is shown that the usage of the algorithm projection order, which equals just 2, allows to increase the depths of the steady-state radiation pattern gaps towards the interference sources about 7 dB in comparison with that of the LC Normalized Least Mean Square algorithm in the same operation conditions. The further increase of the projection order improves the AA performance too, but the improvement is not so significant. So, the projection order can be restricted by the values of 2 … 4, that leads to the low complexity of the AP algorithm.

Author Keywords: Normalized Least Mean Square (NLMS) adaptive filtering algorithm

articleTitle: Adaptive Arrays Based on Real-Valued Arithmetic Linearly-Constrained IQRD RLS Adaptive Filtering Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper presents computational procedures for implementation of multi-beam adaptive antenna arrays with digital beamforming. The weights of the arrays are calculated using the Linearly Constrained Inverse QR Decomposition Recursive Least Squares adaptive filtering algorithms. Two versions of the algorithms are presented: with and without square roots arithmetic operations. The algorithms are fitted to the antenna arrays with odd symmetry. This symmetry allows to develop the adaptive filtering algorithms with most of the computations in real-valued arithmetic. This saves the number of the arithmetic operations required per algorithm iteration. Besides, this implementation decreases the transient response duration and improves the steady-state interference cancellation for about 3 dB in terms of the depths of the radiation pattern gaps towards the interference sources. The efficiency of the proposed solution is demonstrated via simulation of interference cancellation using a rectangular flat adaptive antenna array.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Eigenvalue Problem for a Graphene Strip Placed in the Center of a Circular Dielectric Rod: Hypersingular Integral Equations and Symmetry Classes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We study the electromagnetic eigenvalue problem, adapted to the analysis of the lasing threshold conditions, for the TE-polarized modes of a circular rod made of the gain material, with a flat graphene strip inside. Thanks to the twofold symmetry, the modes split to four independent classes. In each symmetry class, the eigenvalue problem is reduced to a pair of the hypersingular integral equations (IE), serving as a basis for further numerical analysis.

articleTitle: Characteristic Impedances of Rectangular and Circular Waveguides for Fundamental Modes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper we analyze possible approaches for the calculation of characteristic impedances of rectangular and circular waveguides operating at their fundamental modes. Theoretical estimation and comparison of characteristic impedances is necessary for designing of modern microwave devices based of guides with different types of cross-sections. For waveguides the characteristic impedance is not a unique value. The paper presents three possible approaches to determine the characteristic impedances of waveguides. The definitions of the maximum voltage and current in the waveguide are proposed. Obtained formulas for characteristic impedances can be used in the development of various microwave devices based on rectangular and circular waveguides. The maximal voltage, current and average power have been defined for the fundamental TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> mode of a rectangular waveguide. Based on these values the characteristic impedances for a rectangular waveguide have been obtained. The characteristic impedance for a rectangular waveguide is a product of a coefficient, ratio of narrow and broad wall sizes of a waveguide and its wave impedance. Besides, the maximal voltage, current and average power have been defined for the fundamental TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> mode of a circular waveguide. Using these values, the characteristic impedances for a circular waveguide were obtained. The characteristic impedance for a circular waveguide equals to a product of a coefficient and its wave impedance.

articleTitle: Modern Microwave Polarizers and Their Electromagnetic Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper we carry out the review of modern microwave waveguide polarizers, describe their main types, investigate their operation theoretical foundations and obtain analytically the formulas for calculation of their fundamental electromagnetic characteristics. Two theoretical techniques for the decomposition of an electromagnetic wave with any polarization type into two independent components with orthogonal polarizations are described. There are several equivalent characteristics of polarization purity estimation. The most frequently used characteristics are the axial ratio, cross polarization isolation and differential phase shift introduced by the investigated waveguide polarizer. The matching of the waveguide polarizer is characterized by voltage standing wave ratio or by the return losses of the structure. There exists the effect of influence of the matching quality on polarization state of the electromagnetic wave at the output of any waveguide polarizer. Consequently, the differential phase shift can't be applied as a single characteristic of the polarization performance of a waveguide device. For the improvement and clarification of the characteristics of polarization state of electromagnetic wave we have introduced the amplitudes of transmitted through the structure waves into the theoretical formulas of the axial ratio and cross polarization isolation of the microwave waveguide devices. Obtained rigorous mathematical formulas for polarization characteristics can be widely used for the development of various microwave polarization processing devices including orthomode transducers and waveguide polarizers of modern satellite information systems and radars.

articleTitle: Satellite Image Segmentation Using Deep Learning for Deforestation Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The problem of automatic monitoring the deforestation process is considered for efficient prevention of illegal deforestation. Image segmentation model on the basis of U-Net family of deep neural networks (DNNs) was created. The forest/deforestation dataset was collected by parsing areas of Ukrainian forestries, where satellite images of 512×512 pixels contain areas with forest, deforestation, and other areas. The dataset with satellite imagery and segmented masks was uploaded at GitHub repository where it is available with the correspondent code for distributed training on tensor processing units (TPU). To overcome the imbalance of created dataset the hybrid loss function was created and tested in the training environment. K-fold cross validation and numerous runs for different random seeds were conducted to prove the model and dataset usefulness and stability during the training and validation process. The following asymptotic values of intersection over union (IOU) mean <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(IOU_{mean})$</tex> and standard deviation <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(IOU_{std})$</tex> were obtained after more than 100 epochs: <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$IOU_{mean}^{kfold}=0.52, IOU_{std}^{kfold}=0.03$</tex> for cross-validation, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$IOU_{mean}^{random}=0.51, IOU_{std}^{random}=0.03$</tex> for various random seed initialization. These results demonstrate that variation of images in the dataset and randomness of initialization have no significant effect on model performance, but the future research will be needed in the view of the possible increase of datasets where performance could be improved by the larger data representation, but some decrease of performance could be observed due to possible wider data variability. It is especially important for deployment of U-Net-like DNNS on devices with the limited computational resources for Edge Computing layer.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Lung Disease Based on Medical Images Using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The rapid development of technological advances, due to which computer algorithms for image analysis compete with professionals in terms of accuracy, but remain unchanged in speed and volume of cases. In recent years, advances in machine learning and the implementation of convolutional neural networks have improved the ability to classify and identify objects. There is strong evidence that such models can match or outperform experts in complex tasks such as imaging and word processing, recognition and classification, decision-making based on abstract representations, and even clinical decision-making. The purpose of this work is to study the existing methods of developing the architecture of the convolutional neural network and design our own model with subsequent implementation for the diagnosis of digital medical (X-ray) images for the presence of lung disease. As a result of the work, the methods of designing the architecture of convolutional neural networks were analyzed and researched, the main advantages and disadvantages of network optimization means were determined, and the software in which the trained model was implemented was developed.

articleTitle: Dual Battery Powered Drive System Using an Open-End Winding Brushless DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Dual inverter-fed open-end winding (OEW) motor drive is one of the new promising solutions, which has several advantages over standard three-phase drives such as multilevel voltage output, lower DC link voltage, higher efficiency and better fault tolerant capability. In this paper, such an approach has been used for brushless DC motor (BLDCM) drive system, which has significant advantages for low-power electric vehicles. At the first, a possibility of forming of basic vectors in the structure of OEW BLDCM drive is shown for two cases of discrete switching of armature windings with 120-degree and 180-degree switches conductivity. Then, for a simpler 120-degree commutation mode, a control system was developed, which is being characterized by a change in the switching of the two inverters in different modes of the electric drive system operation. In order to increase energy efficiency, a PWM is applied only to one of the inverters. In addition, a simple strategy of charge equalization for two batteries has been developed. The effectiveness of the proposed solutions is confirmed by computer simulation in the Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: Influence of Colour Restoration on Rust Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The use of non-destructive optical methods for inspection of painted surfaces of constructions and the analysis of corrosion damage are considered. For this purpose, the colour image of the tested surface is registered by the digital camera. The detailed analysis of the received image is carried out in the off-line mode. The complexity of the objective quantitative analysis of the affected areas of the surface is due to the influence of the conditions of registration, including lighting and geometric distortions. It requires the development of methods to reduce such dependence. The influence of colour restoration on rust image segmentation is investigated. The colour restoration is performed on the basis of colorimetric values of ColorChecker by the means of least-squares approximation by a linear function. The quality of the colour restoration is evaluated by colour distances between background averaged values in colour space. Rust segmentation is performed using Gaussian mixture models based on maximum likelihood. Image alignment is applied for the correct assessment of changes in the resulting segmentation. Experimental results are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Magneto-Mechanical Characteristic of Double Three-phase PMSM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article studies the performance of a multiphase brushless synchronous motor with excitation from permanent magnets (PMSM). The motor has two sets of independent and unconnected three-phase windings on the stator, which resulting magneto-move forces are shifted by 30 electrical degrees. These windings are supplied with two independent three-phase current systems. The study is based on the analysis of the so-called magnetic mechanical characteristic (MMC) as a multidimensional dependence of the flux linkages of the phase windings and the machine electromagnetic torque from all phase currents and the angle of the rotor position. The analysis is based of the FEM calculation of the 2D machine magnetic field. The mutual influence of dependent and independent MMC variables have been researched with changes in the magnitude of load currents, the initial phases of these currents and the angle of the rotor position. The obtained calculation results are analyzed with regard to the expansion of the machine speed range in the constant power mode at field-oriented control (FOC).

Author Keywords: modular electric machine of PMSM type

articleTitle: Method for Calculation Controlled Compensating Devices Parameters Extra High Voltage Power Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: One of the main elements of the power system is the extra high voltage transmission lines, which are systemforming for the bulk electric networks. The normal operation of the integrated power system depends on the reliability and efficiency of operation transmission line. To ensure efficient operation of the extra high voltage transmission line, it is necessary to optimize the voltage mode and reactive power. Optimization of the transmission line mode operation by minimizing the losses of active power in it, should be based on solving problems of optimization of voltage and reactive power. The control of the operating mode of the transmission line is the correct choice of the composition of the charging power compensation devices in order to regulate the voltage levels and power factors on the bus terminals. Optimization of the transmission line modes operation in this problem statement is performed, focusing on some of the most significant mode parameters. It should also be noted that previous studies have not addressed issues related to the corona discharge of wires and its impact on voltage distribution and the feasibility of depth regulation in lines of this voltage class. One of the measures to reduce electricity losses is to optimize the operating modes of transmission lines in terms of voltage and reactive power.

articleTitle: Lipid Nanocarriers Impede Side Effects of Delivered Antimicrobial Peptide
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Targeted delivery of pharmaceuticals with the help of nano-sized carriers is considered as a new paradigm in personalized medicine. It allows reducing the bulk amount of a drug while providing effective on-site concentration of acting agent. Antimicrobial decapeptide gramicidin S is effective against many bacteria, some fungi and viruses but is used only externally due to the hemolytic activity. It is assumed that for certain topically applied medicines encapsulation into liposomal or micellar delivery vehicles may alleviate their side-effects and the whole body burden. To test this hypothesis for antimicrobial drug gramicidin S (GrS) we have compared the effects of neat GrS and GrS encapsulated into spherical 100 nm liposomes on morphological and functional properties of human red blood cells (RBC). With the help of optical scattering and resistive pulse spectroscopy methods we have studied the effect of bare GS and GS-liposome complexes on shape, volume and electro osmotic properties of human red blood cells upon preliminary incubation. We accessed cell volume, critical dielectric breakdown voltage and membrane resistance to acid hemolysis. Idea appeared to be true partially - liposomal delivery of GrS may increase hemolytic concentration of antibiotic and widen therapeutic window for its system application, while high GrS concentrations (above 20 mM) are still harmful for RBC regardless of the way of drug administration - with nano-carriers or without.

articleTitle: Using KD-tree for Algorithm of Electromagnetic Scattering Calculation on Complex Shape Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The problems of modeling the propagation and diffraction of electromagnetic waves are important not only in electrodynamics. For example, such modeling is used in rendering. Many applied problems have stimulated the development of new approaches to such modeling. This paper discusses various modeling methods that are used in computer graphics problems. One of the most efficient approaches used for rendering tasks is applied to obtain information about the field scattered by complex shape object.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Oil-Filled Equipment with X-Wax Deposition Based on Dissolved Gas Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The results of gas content analysis for 90 high voltage bushings with X-wax deposition are presented. Based on the analysis of gas percentage values, gas ratios and defect nomograms, it is found that X-wax deposition is accompanied by both low-temperature heating and electrical discharges, as well as a combination of these defects. The results of the analysis of gas-content dynamics during X-wax deposition showed that at the initial stage of the process defects of thermal nature occur, which develop into discharges, which is in good agreement with previously published results. A comparative analysis of the X-wax recognition reliability using the criteria and norms regulated by the current standards and the author's methods has been carried out. The obtained results will allow increasing reliability of high voltage bushings diagnostics by results of dissolved gases analysis in oil.

articleTitle: An Universal Bidirectional Three-Port DC/DC/AC Converter With Isolated AC Port
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A topology of versatile unsiversal three-port DC/DC/AC converter with isolated AC port is presented. The converter is based on LLC converter schematic that has been massively modified for providing bidirectional DC-to-AC conversion with galvanic isolation by high-frequency transformer. Besides, a bidirectional DC-DC conversion option is implemented on DC side. In overall, the proposed converter topology allows to combine a number of functions in one single device, i.e.: DC-AC converter for uninterruptible power supply; AC-DC converter for battery charging (or welding as an option); grid-tie inverter for renewable sources (PV panels); DC-DC converter for vehicle cranking or battery-powered welding. The converter is single stage, utilizing direct conversion principle, has no intermediate DC link. Moreover, the topology allows to implement “integrated magnetics” approach by using a transformer with a controlled leakage inductance

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Current Control Based on Space-Vector Operation Technique for Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A simple vector strategy for controlling the compensation current of a three-phase shunt active power filter (SAPF), which is based on the forced introduction of a first-order sliding mode is proposed. SAPF consists of a semiconductor voltage inverter with fully controlled switches, a capacitive storage and a single-link RL filter. Decomposition of the object of study according to the moving rates of the dynamic system allows to distinguish a fast subsystem that implements the vector method of controlling the compensation current, and a slow subsystem, the function of which is to stabilize the constant voltage of the drive capacitor. The DC voltage stabilization of the capacitive storage is performed using a finite twisting algorithm, which belongs to the class of the second order sliding modes. The first-order two-dimensional sliding mode to generate the compensation current is used. The proposed algorithm is a vector-type algorithm and uses the methods of projective geometry to unambiguously determine the mutual location of spatial vectors of voltages and errors of power supply currents. The algorithm is quite simple to implement, because it lacks difficult mathematical operations for calculating inverse trigonometric functions. The selection of the required output voltage vector of the SAPF inverter is determined by determining the location of the spatial vector of equivalent control in a stationary coordinate system α-β, the components of which are calculated in real time. The current tracking error sign using a quasi-stationary two-dimensional sliding surface and a circle-tolerant figure is estimated. The sliding surface is a linear combination of components of the two-dimensional current error vector of the RL filter. A simulation model was built and the simulation results are analyzed.

articleTitle: The Development of Electrical and Radio engineering: the Role of M. Krylov and M. Bogolyubov's Nonlinear Mechanics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article is devoted to the history of the development of asymptotic theory of nonlinear oscillations (nonlinear mechanics), created by M. Krylov and M. Bogolyubov in Kyiv in the early 1930s. Its significance for the elaboration of electrical and radio engineering is emphasized. The key evolutionary events related to the theory of nonlinear oscillations are covered. Among them are Lee de Forrest's invention of the triode lamp in 1906, activity of teams led by G. Barkhausen and G. Möller in Germany (1907–1921), B. Van der Pol in Holland (1922–1929), L.Mandelstam (USSR) (since 1925), M. M. Krylov and M. M. Bogolyubov in Kyiv, Ukraine (since 1927). It is shown that M. Krylov and M. Bogolyubov developed mathematical method for the study of general conservative systems with a small parameter, and on this base - methods for considering quasi-periodic modes in an electronic generator, which is periodically affected by an external force. In 1932 M. Bogolyubov made according report at the First Electrotechnical Congress in Paris. It was highlighted that M. Bogolyubov had significantly influenced the development of physical, mathematical and technical sciences at the Institute of Mathematics, Kyiv University and Institute of Theoretical Physics. The reconstruction of the intellectual portrait of the M. Bogolyubov, carried out on the basis of the interviews, is also given.

articleTitle: DSP-based Cross-Correlator for the Analysis of Dynamic Light Scattering Data for Biomedical Investigation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A method of mathematical analysis of polarization components of dynamic light scattering by nanoscale objects of non-spherical shape in suspensions has been developed for a modified scheme of a laser correlation spectrometer. The proposed method of regularization of the inverse spectral problem allows to obtain stable solutions for estimating the shape and aspect ratios of the studied nanoobjects. A specialized measuring and computing device and software for the practical implementation of these instrumental methods have been developed. The measurement system has been tested to study the processes of activation of immune reactions such as antigen-antibody with the formation of aggregate complexes of reactive components.

abstract: In the article the design of an ignition device for high-pressure gas discharge lamps based on a voltage piezoelectric transformer has been proposed. articleTitle: Constant-Parameter Discretized State-Space Model of Saturable Induction Machines for Fixed Time-step Simulations
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Design and analysis of today's power systems are highly dependent on various simulation programs and platforms (including real-time FPGA-based hardware-in-the-loop simulators), that require accurate and numerically efficient models of all power system components. Induction machines are widely used in power systems and have numerous well-documented qd-models in the literature that also include magnetic saturation. However, such models are nonlinear and generally, when discretized, will have variable parameters, which makes their use costly in transient simulation studies of large-scale power systems. This paper proposes a constant-parameter discretized qd state-space model for induction machines including the main flux saturation. The presented formulation achieves constant-parameters, and therefore, the proposed model is shown to have superior numerical efficiency with minimal compromise in numerical accuracy. It is envisioned that the presented model may be a suitable for large-scale power systems studies in simulators with small time steps.

articleTitle: Correction of the Maximum Permissible Values of the Oil Acidity by the Minimum Risk Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 3rd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Based on the statistical analysis of the periodic test results of transformer oils condition for 231 transformers of 110 kV voltage the correction of the maximum permissible values of organic acid content in oil was carried out. It was found that the maximum permissible values of the oil acidity, obtained by minimizing the average risk function, for transformers, which are operated with different values of the loading factor, significantly differ. The analysis shows that the correction of the maximum permissible values of the oil acidity by the minimum risk method taking into account the transformers' operation period and loading allows reducing the risks by 1.2-1112.5 times in comparison with the risks accompanied by using the maximum permissible values regulated by known standards. To minimise operational risks, the maximum permissible values have to be defined according to the specific operating conditions of power transformers.
